|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/endofareign.html</ref>

The first Used function is okay, [[Overseeing It Personally]] was a nasty "kicker" in the old-style [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire{{!}}Ralltiir Operations]] decks. But with [[Ounee Ta]] being a more effective Raltiir Ops counter, this function alone will not justify its inclusion in most decks.

The second Used function though is a great one with immense versatility. Not cheap, but to remove Dark Lord Of The Sith's choke or EPP [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s weapon for a turn could swing a situation your way.

The Lost function is also not too shabby! Emperor sees a lot of play, often in multiples so people aren't afraid to forfeit him in order to deploy another from hand. This could make them hesitate for just a second!

That's a destiny 4 interrupt that works with two of the most popular Dark Side characters in the game! Definitely worth consideration in a host of Light Side decks!
